fusions.name: Seizing Cast
fusions.desc: Closes a chain around an enemy up to 5 tiles away that deals 14 damage, up to 1.4 times that at full reach, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Vise Ring
fusions.desc: Whirls a ring of links around you that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Steadying Line
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Tightening Hold
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a shield worth 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
